approach: Write the standard trajectory equation from the given velocity components, then match its coefficients to the given form to read off γ.

steps.text: Write the trajectory equation using the given velocity components and g = 10 m/s².
Rewrite the expression with a common factor of 1/9, matching the given form.
Compare with y = (1/9)(βx + γx²) to read off γ.

common_mistakes.text: Forgetting to divide by 2 in the term gx²/(2v_x²) doubles that coefficient, giving γ = −10, which does not match any of the printed choices.
